primary_target: original A1 factual-error binary label in {0, 1}; A2=-1 remains missing
repeated_retention: one binary label variable per unique response (unit_id); sum weighted coefficients across repeated appearances before optimizing endpoints

scenarios.missing_annotation_envelope: observed agreement (A1==A2, A2 in {0,1}) fixes [A1]; observed disagreement or missing A2 permits [0, 1]
scenarios.observed_disagreement: observed agreement (A1==A2, A2 in {0,1}) and missing A2 (A2==-1) fix [A1]; observed disagreement (A1!=A2, A2 in {0,1}) permits [0, 1]

selection: no mask, A2, endpoint or sensitivity result selects training, temperature, promotion or primary acceptance

weights.retention_measurement: 1/3000 per stream-qid-sibling appearance; 1/300 per unique TEST response across 10 streams
